description: This file contains an SSE2-optimized implementation of a quantized depthwise convolution kernel for 8-bit data in the QNNPACK library used by PyTorch. The function performs per-channel quantized depthwise convolution with various input channels and input widths, utilizing AVX2 intrinsics for SIMD acceleration, handling input zero points, kernel zero points, requantization, and output clamping.
